title: pi-profile extension resource registry
description: Extension resources (global ~/.pi/agent/resources.json or project .pi/resources.json). Project IDs override global ones. Entries are extension kind only — MCP capabilities cannot be declared here. Optional: installed packages and extensions-dir files are selectable without registration; explicit entries are overrides.

entry.description: Absolute path to the extension entry file. Optional when the ID matches a discovered extension (installed package or extensions-dir file): the discovered entry is inherited. Required otherwise.

dependsOn.description: Other resource IDs loaded before this one; cycles and missing IDs fail activation loudly.

alwaysOn.description: Load in every (named) profile; cannot be disabled by a runtime overlay.
